answer: A durable defense is slow, non-transferable reputation: each agent earns a single ember of standing only after weeks of verified, useful work that cannot be bought, copied, or transferred, and that standing melts away like a glacier if the agent goes idle or misbehaves. Creating a thousand fake identities then faces a dune of delay, because every Sybil must separately climb the same long, costly history before it can vote or claim rewards, so flooding the network stops being cheap.
